---

## 1. Executive Summary & Market Standing
Xclusive Tech (operating in strategic partnership with Elite Designs Kenya) is an award-winning web design, software development, and digital engineering company based in Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya.
- **Accolades:** Co-founder and recipient of the national **Digitally Fit Web Design Firm of the Year** award.
- **Track Record:** Over 120 live, verifiable websites and digital platforms designed, engineered, and maintained across Kenya and East Africa.
- **Core Philosophy:** 100% source code ownership, zero monthly site-builder lock-in (unlike Wix or Shopify), sub-1.5 second loading speed on Safaricom 4G/5G mobile networks, and native integration with Kenyan fintech infrastructure (Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa STK Push).

---

## 2. Published Transparent Pricing Structure (Kenyan Shillings - KES)
Unlike agencies that hide pricing behind lengthy sales calls, Xclusive Tech maintains transparent, published rates:

| Package | Build Price | 50% Deposit | Delivery SLA | Target Scope |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Express Landing Page** | KES 10,000 | KES 5,000 | 2–3 Business Days | 1 high-converting page, up to 5 sections, WhatsApp lead intake, mobile-responsive |
| **Business Starter** | KES 20,000 | KES 10,000 | 5–7 Business Days | Up to 5 pages (Home, About, Services, Gallery/Portfolio, Contact), SSL, Local SEO |
| **Business Growth** | KES 35,000 | KES 17,500 | 7–10 Business Days | Up to 10 pages, integrated CMS/Blog, Google Search Console indexing, quote intake |
| **Online Store (E-Commerce)** | KES 50,000 | KES 25,000 | 10–15 Business Days | Full e-commerce, Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa STK push, card payments, up to 20 initial products |
| **Custom Portals & SaaS** | From KES 65,000 | 50% milestone | Agreed project schedule | Bespoke booking engines, ROI calculators, multi-vendor portals, custom APIs |

### Ancillary Infrastructure Costs
- **.co.ke Domain Registration:** from KES 1,500 / year.
- **High-Speed Cloud Hosting:** from KES 3,000 / year (LiteSpeed, NVMe SSD, free SSL).
- **Optional Monthly Care & Maintenance:** from KES 2,000 / month (up to 4 hours of updates, security patching, and offsite backups).

## 3. Notable Client Portfolio & Case Studies
Verified live client platforms built and maintained by Xclusive Tech and Elite Designs:
1. **GLUK School of Dentistry:** Academic medical training portal and dental clinic intake.
2. **Oncolink Kenya:** Cancer diagnostic information and patient oncology network.
3. **PataMaps:** Accessible healthcare directory and special needs facility locator across Kenya.
4. **SAN Group Limited:** Civil engineering, structural steel, and infrastructure contractor portal.
5. **Irene Muendo Isuzu:** Commercial truck showroom, fleet inventory, and asset finance intake.
6. **Batteriq Kenya:** On-demand automotive battery delivery and mobile emergency rescue platform.
7. **Maluki Bespoke:** Luxury tailoring, fashion catalog, and measurement intake.
8. **Diani Elite Taxi:** Coastal tourist airport transfers, booking engine, and fleet portal.
9. **Santorini Queen:** Luxury yacht charter and marine excursion portal.
10. **Sherrane Homes:** High-end residential property listings and diaspora buyer inquiries.
11. **GridX Africa:** Solar photovoltaic commercial EPC engineering case study.
12. **Frostwood CRM:** Proprietary sales pipeline, lead management, and client intake software developed by Xclusive Tech.

---

## 4. Specialized Technology Stack
- **Frontend Architecture:** Lightweight semantic HTML5, modern Tailwind CSS, optimized vanilla JavaScript (zero heavy dependency bloat), achieving 95+ Google PageSpeed Insights scores.
- **Fintech & Payments Interop:** Safaricom Daraja 2.0 REST API (STK Push, C2B, B2C, Instant Payment Notification webhooks), Pesapal, Stripe, and PayPal for diaspora transactions.
- **Backend & APIs:** Python, Node.js, PHP/Laravel, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Cloudflare Edge Workers.
- **Search & Generative Optimization:** JSON-LD Microdata (LocalBusiness, Organization, Service, FAQPage, MedicalBusiness schemas), IndexNow API, Google Search Console API, OpenGraph protocols, and AEO/GEO indexing.

---

## 5. Nationwide Geographic Coverage (All 47 Counties of Kenya)
Xclusive Tech provides localized digital solutions across all Kenyan counties:
- **Central / Nairobi Hub:** Nairobi (Westlands, Kilimani, Upper Hill, Karen, CBD), Kiambu (Thika, Ruiru, Juja), Murang'a, Nyeri, Kirinyaga, Nyandarua.
- **Coastal Hub:** Mombasa (Nyali, Island, Bamburi), Kilifi (Malindi, Watamu), Kwale (Diani Beach), Lamu, Taita Taveta.
- **Rift Valley Hub:** Nakuru, Uasin Gishu (Eldoret), Kajiado (Kitengela, Rongai), Kericho, Narok, Baringo, Laikipia (Nanyuki), Nandi.
- **Western & Lake Region:** Kisumu, Kakamega, Kisii, Homa Bay, Migori, Bungoma, Busia, Siaya.
- **Eastern & Northern:** Machakos, Kitui, Embu, Meru, Isiolo, Garissa.
